(async()=>{await document.fonts.load('42px "H2O2 Macintosh"','H2O2');await document.fonts.ready;const signature=document.querySelector('.maker-name');const font=[...document.fonts].find(f=>f.family.includes('H2O2 Macintosh'));if(!font||font.status!=='loaded')throw Error('Signature font did not load');if(signature.textContent!=='H2O2')throw Error('Signature text mismatch');if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('Page overflow');const footer=document.querySelector('.footer-bottom').getBoundingClientRect(),mark=signature.getBoundingClientRect();if(mark.right>footer.right||mark.left<footer.left)throw Error('Signature overflow');return {font:font.family,status:font.status,viewport:innerWidth,text:document.querySelector('.maker-signature').textContent,fontSize:getComputedStyle(signature).fontSize};})()
